lines.en: - They stink.
- Thanks.
- No, I'm serious.
- Well, that's just 'cause I went down there
and they were all smoking.
- This is actually the smell of success.
- Look, it is something different to--
- Oh, my God, you smoked.
- I did not.
- Yes, you did, you look happy and sick, you smoked.
- All right, fine, but I had to,
I had to do it for my career.
- Wish I had to smoke for my career.
- That is so gross.
- No, it's not that bad, you know?
It's, I mean, yeah, my tongue feels a little fuzzy
and my fingers sort of smell.
I actually feel like I could throw up.
- Okay, but you gotta push past this, okay,
because it's about to get so good.
- Chandler, oh, I can tell you, you smell so smoky,
I gotta get up, I'm not kidding.
- I think you smell great.
- I'm not kidding. - I'm not kidding.
